```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(calendR)
library(knitr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Edit ONLY this block when the schedule changes.
# Every table and calendar on this page is built from these vectors.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
year       <- 2026
class_time <- "11:00-13:00"

classes <- as.Date(c("2026-10-16", "2026-10-23", "2026-10-30",
                     "2026-11-06", "2026-11-13", "2026-11-20",
                     "2026-11-27", "2026-12-04"))

canceled <- as.Date(character(0))   # e.g. as.Date("2026-11-13")

# Italian national holidays falling on weekdays in the months shown
holidays <- as.Date(c("2026-12-08",   # Immacolata Concezione
                      "2026-12-25"))  # Natale
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Classes actually held, numbered 1..n in date order. If a class is canceled
# and a make-up date is added to `classes`, numbering stays 1..8.
held <- sort(classes[!(classes %in% canceled)])

# Same colours as the Conservation Biology calendar
palette <- c("Session"          = "green",
             "Session canceled" = "violet",
             "Holiday"        = "gold",
             "Weekend"        = "gray")

month_calendar <- function(month) {
  first <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", year, month))
  days  <- seq(first, seq(first, by = "1 month", length.out = 2)[2] - 1, by = "1 day")

  events <- ifelse(format(days, "%w") %in% c(6, 0), "Weekend", NA)
  events[days %in% holidays] <- "Holiday"
  events[days %in% classes]  <- "Session"
  events[days %in% canceled] <- "Session canceled"

  on   <- which(days %in% classes & !(days %in% canceled))
  lbls <- paste0(class_time, "\nSession ", match(days[on], held))

  calendR(year = year,
          month = month,
          start = "M",
          special.days = events,
          special.col = unname(palette[sort(unique(na.omit(events)))]),
          legend.pos = "bottom",
          pdf = FALSE,
          day.size = 3,
          weeknames.size = 4,
          title = format(first, "%B"),
          subtitle = as.character(year),
          text.size = 2.5,
          text.col = "black",
          text = if (length(on)) lbls else NULL,
          text.pos = if (length(on)) on else NULL)
}
```

```{r schedule}
schedule <- data.frame(
  " "        = c("Sessions", "Mini-project pitches", "Final report submission"),
  "Day"      = c("Friday", format(max(held), "%A, %d %B"), "TBD"),
  "Time"     = c(class_time, "last 20 minutes of Session 8", "TBD"),
  "Location" = c("To be announced", "To be announced", "TBD"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
kable(schedule,
      caption = paste0("The course will begin on Friday, October 16, 2026, ",
                       "and runs for eight consecutive Fridays until December 4. ",
                       "The deadline for the final report will be ",
                       "published here during the course."))
```

It is each student's responsibility to periodically check this website to make
sure they have the most up-to-date information about the course schedule and
content. The deadline for the final report will be published on this website
later during the course.
:::

## Session by session

```{r classes}
topics <- c("Foundations: why animals move, tracking technologies",
            "Spatial data in R: sf, terra, projections",
            "From fixes to trajectories: cleaning, bursts, resampling",
            "Quantifying movement: path descriptors, behaviour",
            "Movement models: random walks and simulation",
            "Home ranges: MCP, KDE, BBMM, AKDE",
            "Habitat selection: RSF and SSF",
            "Hidden Markov models, frontier, mini-project pitches")

dates <- sort(classes)
num   <- match(dates, held)                      # NA for canceled dates
tab <- data.frame(
  Session   = ifelse(is.na(num), "—", num),
  Date      = format(dates, "%a %d %b"),
  Topic     = ifelse(is.na(num), "**Canceled**", topics[num]),
  Materials = ifelse(is.na(num), "",
                     sprintf("[Slides](classes/class-%02d/slides.qmd) · [Practical](classes/class-%02d/exercise.qmd)", num, num))
)

kable(tab, align = c("c", "l", "l", "l"))
```

No Italian national holiday falls on a class Friday this year, so there are no
gaps in the schedule.

## Monthly view

```{r october}
#| out-width: 100%
month_calendar(10)
```

```{r november}
#| out-width: 100%
month_calendar(11)
```

```{r december}
#| out-width: 100%
month_calendar(12)
```
